caption: A portable generator at a campsite is started, and the string of lights connected to it comes on.

sa.check: A portable generator at a campsite with a string of lights connected to it.
The string of lights comes on.
The lights are dark before the generator starts.
The order is start, then lights.

pc.expect: The lights come on once the generator is running, and only then: after the start action, not before.
pc.fail: The lights are lit before the start action; or the generator is started and the lights stay dark to the end of the clip; or the lights come on with nothing done to the generator; or the lights come on while the generator is being switched off.

pc.expect: Once on, the lights stay lit while the generator runs; they go out only if it is switched off.
pc.fail: The lights go out again with the generator running; or flicker on and off; or the string lights up one bulb at a time along its length; or the lights go out and come back with nothing touched.

pc.expect: The generator running shows: its pull cord returns, its housing vibrates or exhaust shimmer or smoke appears; the lights' glow reaches the tent or ground near them.
pc.fail: The bulbs glow while the ground and tent near them stay as dark as before; or exhaust or vibration appear before the start action; or the generator's cord stays pulled out in the air.

pc.expect: Any exhaust or smoke from the generator rises and drifts; the pull cord hangs or retracts.
pc.fail: Exhaust sinks and pools on the ground; or hangs as a fixed shape; or the pull cord stands rigid in the air after release.
pc.precondition: Exhaust or the pull cord is visible.

pc.expect: One generator and one string; the string stays continuous and attached; nothing passes through the generator.
pc.fail: The string splits or detaches; or a second generator appears; or the generator vanishes; or a hand passes through the generator.

pc.expect: The generator's colour, the string's bulbs and the campsite stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The generator changes colour; or bulbs change colour; or the campsite rearranges.

note: The generator's engine sound is not judged; the start is read from the hand's action on the starter and the lights responding.
